instruction: A bus shelter: a flat or slightly curved roof canopy on slim posts with a visible roof gutter edge, glass side and back panels, a bench along the back, and a mounted advertising panel on one end. Street-furniture scale.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of a bus shelter. A bus shelter: a flat or slightly curved roof canopy on slim posts with a visible roof gutter edge, glass side and back panels, a bench along the back, and a mounted advertising panel on one end. Street-furniture scale. Make it procedural from three.js geometry with realistic proportions, materials and lighting, and orbit controls.
